users.label: Users
users.description: Every account on this instance: the global role, whether the address is confirmed, and the projects each user can reach.

teams.label: Teams
teams.description: Every team on this instance: the projects it owns and who belongs to it.

projects.label: Projects
projects.description: Every project on this instance: what each one holds, when it was last active, and who can reach it.

roles.label: System roles
roles.description: Default roles available to every team on this instance.

general.label: General
general.description: Personal workspaces, defaults for new projects, agent traces, and the agent run time limit.

authentication.label: Authentication
authentication.description: Who may register on this instance, how accounts are confirmed, and the providers people sign in with.

hotkeys.label: Keyboard shortcuts
hotkeys.description: The key each command is bound to for everyone on this instance. Each person can rebind a shortcut for their own account in their preferences.

storage.label: Storage
storage.description: How much people may upload: the size of a single file, the attachment types accepted, and the storage each project gets.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.description: The bot people connect their Telegram account to, and the one that delivers Telegram notifications for projects that set no bot of their own.

auth-provider.label: Auth provider
auth-provider.description: The external accounts people may sign in with.

scim.label: SCIM
scim.description: Let an identity provider create, update and deactivate accounts on this instance, and grant project access through its groups.

audit-log.label: Audit log
audit-log.description: Who did what on this instance, when, and where they did it from.

general.label: Chung

states.label: Trạng thái

actions.label: Hành động nhanh

forms.label: Forms
forms.description: Let anyone with a link file an issue here.

import-export.label: Nhập/Xuất dữ liệu

ai-agents.label: AI của dự án

queue.label: Lượt chạy AI

previews.available: Available in Cloud and self-hosted Pro.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Activity across the teams and projects of this workspace.

agentBudgets.title: AI budgets
agentBudgets.description: Limits on what agents spend on models.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Who did what in this workspace, its teams and projects, and when its people signed in.

emailDomains.title: Email domains
emailDomains.description: Choose which email domains can join this workspace.
emailDomains.label: Allowed email domains
emailDomains.hint: Only addresses at these domains can be invited or added through SCIM, and invited people can sign up with them. Leave empty to use the instance's domains. Current members keep their access.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.description: Let people of this workspace sign in with your company's identity provider.
sso.providerHint: Enter what your identity provider gives you, then add the addresses below to it.

forms.questionsHint: Name and email are always asked.
forms.name: Your name

portal.title: Portal
portal.description: The page where people send requests to the workspace's projects and follow them.
portal.formsHint: The workspace's projects can publish forms anyone with the link fills in. Off, their forms and portals stop opening and the projects lose their Forms settings; nothing is deleted.
portal.name: Name
portal.nameHint: What people see on the portal and in its emails in place of the workspace's name. Empty shows the workspace's name.
portal.addressHint: The portal opens at this address. Until you set one, it opens at the workspace's number.
portal.logoHint: Shown on the portal and on the forms in place of the portal's name. One logo serves both themes.
